name: Perilous Bed

attributes.attribute: a magical bed that cut whoever lay on it

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: The Perilous Bed is an Arthurian place unknown in the real world. It appeared to knights who sought the Grail. It looked soft and warm, but whoever lay on it was cut by unseen knives, until the knight Gawain destroyed the thing.

okr.objective: Describe the Perilous Bed of the Arthurian tales.
key_results: Name it as a place that appears to Grail seekers
Describe the invisible blades that cut the sleeper
Note that Gawain destroyed the dangerous object
